messages:
sam.sales: Kicking off thread for OrionTelco pilot — need to align on scope: DPA addendum, SOC2 artifacts, EU-only residency, and a scheduled pen-test window. Also confirm pilot fee and success metrics.
laura.se: Quick context: goal = replace manual routing assistant. Pilot length 12 weeks. Key SLOs: p99 latency <=300ms for single-turn prompts, <=2s for multi-turn threads. Data must reside in EU-W region.
mike.security: We can share SOC2 Type II summary + certs via SSO link. DPA needs subprocessors list and data deletion flow. Pen-test: customer wants third-party test against Private VPC; require PO + SOW.
alex.engineer: Which deployment are they choosing? Private VPC per last call? Need to know model variant (we suggested rwd-medium-2025-q4) and quantization level to estimate latency.
sam.sales: Yes they want Private VPC. They signed NDA already. Model: rwd-medium, open to int8 quantized config to hit latency.
julia.pmo: Draft timeline proposal:
- Day 0: DPA & SOW signed
- Day 3: infra creds + access
- Day 4-10: model onboarding & perf tuning
- Day 11-17: internal evals & prewarm
- Day 18-60: customer pilot + live evals
- Day 84: close & decision
Is this ok?
alex.engineer: Sounds doable. Infra provisioning needs 5 business days from ticket creation. Add 48h buffer before pen-test. Also require customer IP allowlist and tester IP ranges.
ryan.sales: Pricing Q: do we include compute in the pilot fee or bill tokens? Recommend fixed pilot fee to cover baseline compute + support, then overage billing.
sam.sales: Proposal: 14,000 EUR pilot fee for 12 weeks covering 1 small Dedicated pool + two onboarding eng days + 8x5 support; overage billed per token. I need finance ok.
mike.security: Pen-test constraints: approved vendor only, tests run inside customer VPC, no host-level access to Redwood control plane, 72h notice, and a runbook required. We'll require findings to be submitted to Redwood security first.
laura.se: Customer success criteria (Orion):
- >=30% faster routing decisions
- suggestion acceptance >=65%
- latency SLOs met
- zero PII leaked in responses (automated checks)
They will provide 200 labelled prompts for evals.
alex.engineer: For eval harness we will run: latency distribution (p50/p95/p99), throughput under target RPS, semantic accuracy vs labels, and leakage scans. We'll provide a dockerized eval runner and sample commands.
sam.sales: Legal asks: DPA with EU residency clause, subprocessor disclosure, and a limited right-to-audit (SOC2-based). Customer requested 30-day logs for pilot only — acceptable?
mike.security: 30-day retention OK for pilot. Right-to-audit: provide SOC2 report and compliance summary; full audits need legal approval. DPA will reference EU-only processing for the pilot.
julia.pmo: Action items:
- Collect prompt set + 200 examples from Orion (Orion action)
- Draft pilot SOW with fee and overage terms (Sam)
- Share subprocessor list + SOC2 pack (Mike)
- Create infra ticket for VPC provisioning (Alex)
I'll track these in Asana and set milestones.
ops-bot: INF-4937 created and assigned to alex.engineer. ETA 5 business days.
laura.se: Technical ops note: enable prefix KV caching for session flows to reduce cold-latency. Recommend prewarm step: 1k synthetic sessions to populate KV cache. Estimate ~30 mins on the pool.
alex.engineer: We'll add a prewarm run in the onboarding runbook and a script. Also add metrics collection for p99 and KV hit rate.
ryan.sales: Commercial blocker: legal wants estimated conversion MRR to justify pilot discount. Also need PO before pen-test approval. I'll follow up with procurement.
mike.security: For pen-test, outline allowed attack types in runbook (no physical/hardware exploits, no social engineering attempts). We also require emergency contact list and escalation path.
sam.sales: Sounds good. @mike.security please attach SOC2 summary, subprocessor list, and sample DPA by Monday. @julia.pmo I'll share SOW draft by Tue EOD for review.
laura.se: Acceptance QA checklist for pilot:
1) 200 evals meet accuracy threshold
2) latency p99 <=300ms for short prompts
3) all data processed in EU-W region
4) pen-test completed and critical issues mitigated
If any fail, fallback to hosted canary model until resolved.
sam.sales: Thanks everyone, closing thread for now. Will post SOW when ready. :thumbsup:
